title: Adjacency word entry
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $s,n,k$ be natural numbers with $k<n^2$. The entry at position $k$ of the adjacency word for $N,x,s,n$, using false as the default for an out-of-range position, is true exactly when there is an edge from vertex $ igl\\lfloor k/n\\bigr\\rfloor$ to vertex $k \bmod n$ in the graph defined by $N,x,s$.
